CustomField.label: RLM Billing Start Date
CustomField.description: Asset-Based Ordering shipment-gated billing. For a software subscription bundled with physical hardware, billing is held until shipment; on the shipment/serial-mapping event RLM_ShipmentFulfillmentService stamps the confirmed billing start date here (the shipment date) and, best-effort, defers the real BillingSchedule to match.
